title: Mitochondrial transmission family
goal: A reader can recognize maternal transmission because affected mothers pass the trait to all children and an affected father passes it to none.

rubric.must: Three aligned generation rows are visibly labeled I, II, and III.
The generation-I mother is fully filled and the generation-I father is empty.
Both children descending from the affected generation-I mother are fully filled.
The affected generation-II father has two visibly empty children with his empty partner.
The affected generation-II mother has two visibly fully filled children with her empty partner.
Exactly one proband arrow labeled P points to the affected female III-3.

ideal.notes: Three generations in strict left-to-right numeric order showing both children of each affected mother solid-filled and both children of affected father II-1 empty.
